name: Michilla "Kyla" Blaise
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 5B

items.text: Michilla “Kyla” Blaise is an appointed Chicago Board of Education member. She is a Chicago Public Schools parent and chief of staff for Cook County Commissioner Frank Aguilar. On the board, she introduced a budget amendment that reversed some planned cuts by assuming the district would receive an additional $150 million in uncommitted state funding.

sentences.text: Michilla “Kyla” Blaise is an appointed Chicago Board of Education member.
She is a Chicago Public Schools parent and chief of staff for Cook County Commissioner Frank Aguilar.
On the board, she introduced a budget amendment that reversed some planned cuts by assuming the district would receive an additional $150 million in uncommitted state funding.

items.text: She says she is focused on increasing district funding. She has proposed turning Marshall High School into a sports magnet school or adding middle school grades. At a candidate forum, she argued that career and technical education programs may require greater investment. She pointed to restorative justice and calming spaces as tools schools can use to address student behavior.
